title: Disappointing Finish Work
text: Disappointing Finish Work. I will first say that this is one of the best constructed and heaviest items I've had to review in a long time. Well made for sure. Unfortunately it ends there. The hooks are all just slightly off center. Canted a it to the right or the left. It was spray stained and very unevenly at that. No hanging hardware, just 2 holes drilled through the top. The worst thing is the text at the top is totally not centered up between the hanging holes. This could have been an awesome product if more attention was given to the fit and finish.
